items.event: El Clásico: Barcelona vs Real Madrid (LaLiga, Matchday 10)
items.line: Both sides won their first three league games. Mourinho's first Clásico back at Real Madrid, at Spotify Camp Nou. Barcelona have won six of the last seven meetings, and one preview says Vinícius Júnior will miss the match.

sources.name: ESPN
sources.title: José Mourinho's first Clásico on Real Madrid return set for Oct. 25
